scenes.title: Home
scenes.description: The house's own launcher: running apps on a clothesline, then the JawnOS apps and the phone's own.
scenes.alt: The JawnOS Android home screen: a JawnOS app row, a clothesline of running apps and the phone's own app grid.

scenes.title: Gallery
scenes.description: Five albums with their painted covers, counted and opened in place.
scenes.alt: The JawnOS Gallery on Android, showing five albums with painted covers and a photo count for each.

scenes.title: Music
scenes.description: Three albums from the studio, their covers and tracks, played from the house's own library.
scenes.alt: The JawnOS Music player on Android, listing three albums with covers and the tracks inside them.

scenes.title: Synth
scenes.description: A playable keyboard, effects and a step sequencer, squeezed into a thumb.
scenes.alt: The JawnOS Synth on Android, with a piano keyboard, effect sliders and a step sequencer.

scenes.title: Handbook
scenes.description: Today at a glance: money, the state of life and the records that fill the day.
scenes.alt: The JawnOS Handbook on Android: today's money, the state of life and the day's records.

scenes.title: Accounting
scenes.description: An income statement that ties to the ledger: income, expenses and the net between them.
scenes.alt: The JawnOS Accounting income statement on Android, with income, expenses and net income for the month.

scenes.title: Travel
scenes.description: A hand-drawn map plate, the day's track across it and where the phone is now.
scenes.alt: The JawnOS Travel map on Android, showing a hand-drawn harbour plate, a walk track and a you-are-here marker.

scenes.title: Clock
scenes.description: Alarms, wake ramps and a wind-down, each with its own switch.
scenes.alt: The JawnOS Clock on Android, with three alarms, each with its own switch.
